claims.statement: Does there exist one family of single-valued law-valued sections S_X : M(X) -> J(X), for every finite nonempty typed list X, with m_X after S_X equal to the identity, that is natural under every coordinatewise finite Markov kernel and every admitted marginal-compatible arity-changing presentation kernel including the explicitly admitted binary split kernels R_(1/3) and R_(1/2) defined below, is faithful to every admitted positive full joint law, and satisfies all three of the following independently typed marginal-factorization predicates? (VFE) For every X there exists one function V_X : M(X) x M(X) x (0,infinity) -> extended-real such that V_X(m_X Q,m_X P,z) = -log(z) + KL(Q||P) for every compatible recognition law Q, positive posterior law P, and evidence z>0. (Fisher) Whenever two compatible positive C^1 families p_0,p_1 : Theta -> J(X) on the same parameter space satisfy m_X after p_0 = m_X after p_1 as maps, their pulled-back full-joint Fisher tensors are equal on Theta. (Intervention) Every two compatible enriched presentations with the same marginal observational datum are isomorphic in the declared typed causal/intervention category, and a marginal-to-enrichment reconstruction is a section of the forgetful map up to that type-preserving intervention isomorphism.
claims.quantifiers: There exists a single family (S_X)_X, one section for each finite nonempty typed list X, such that for every coordinatewise finite Markov kernel, every admitted marginal-compatible arity-changing presentation kernel including the explicitly admitted R_(1/3) and R_(1/2), and every admitted positive joint law Q, the section, naturality, and faithfulness requirements in the target statement hold simultaneously; and for every X there exists one V_X with the displayed signature and equality for every compatible (Q,P,z) with P positive and z>0; and for every common parameter space Theta and every pair of compatible positive C^1 families p_0,p_1 : Theta -> J(X) whose complete marginal-family maps agree, their pulled-back full-joint Fisher tensors agree on Theta; and for every marginal observational datum and every pair of its compatible enriched typed intervention presentations, those presentations are type-preservingly intervention-isomorphic and a reconstruction from marginal data is a section of the forgetful map up to that isomorphism.
claims.falsifier: Invalidate the scope-matched split nonexistence proof by showing that one displayed split is not an admitted marginal-compatible kernel, that their descended fair-source data differ, or that their unequal atom multisets become equal under the frozen equivalence.
scope_limits: The refutation is of the frozen existential conjunction; it does not refute reference-relative selectors or selectors on a smaller product-preserving morphism category.

claims.statement: No function of only two singleton-marginal tuples and positive evidence can equal -log(z)+KL(Q||P) for every compatible full recognition joint Q and positive posterior joint P.
claims.quantifiers: For the two-bit typed list, there does not exist one V_X with the frozen signature whose equality holds for every compatible Q, every positive P, and every z>0.
claims.falsifier: Construct a single value at the common input (mQ_0,mP,z)=(mQ_(1/2),mP,z) that equals both exact full-joint VFE values, or invalidate normalization, common marginals, positivity, or exact KL strictness in the witness.

claims.statement: Pulled-back full-joint Fisher information on positive C1 families does not factor through the complete singleton-marginal family map.
claims.quantifiers: There exist two positive C1 full-joint families on one common parameter space whose singleton-marginal maps agree at every parameter but whose pulled-back full-joint Fisher tensors differ.
claims.falsifier: Show that the two parity families fail positivity or familywise marginal equality on the stated domain, or that the exact center Fisher tensors are equal.

claims.statement: No marginal-to-enrichment reconstruction recovers every compatible enriched presentation from marginal observational data by a universal two-sided law R U(E) type-preservingly intervention-isomorphic to E in the frozen declared causal/intervention category.
claims.quantifiers: For every marginal observational datum and every compatible enriched typed intervention presentation E over it in the frozen declared category, no single reconstruction R has R U(E) type-preservingly intervention-isomorphic to E universally.
claims.falsifier: Close the present inconclusive disposition by formalizing the ambient category and then either proving universal fiber uniqueness and two-sided reconstruction or exhibiting admitted nonisomorphic objects in one forgetful fiber.
scope_limits: The full ambient causal/intervention category, object admission, and internal witness nonisomorphism remain unformalized.
This open claim is outside the negative selector target closure.

claims.statement: Conditional on the direct, latent, and null-extended BSC presentations being nonisomorphic objects over one observational forgetful image in a declared type-preserving intervention category, no reconstruction can recover every compatible enrichment in that fiber by a universal two-sided law R U(E) isomorphic to E.
claims.quantifiers: For every declared typed intervention category and forgetful functor satisfying the stated witness hypotheses, there is no reconstruction R for which R U(E) is type-preservingly intervention-isomorphic to E for every compatible enrichment E in the witness fiber.
claims.falsifier: Provide a typed category satisfying the stated nonisomorphic-fiber hypotheses together with a universal two-sided reconstruction, or find an invalid isomorphism step in the conditional contradiction.
scope_limits: This is a conditional implication and does not close RECOVERY-TYPED-INTERVENTION-NOGO.
It does not refute a mere right-inverse section choosing one representative per observational fiber.

claims.statement: A family of marginal sections natural under every coordinatewise finite Markov kernel with independently tensored randomness is uniquely the product coupling family, and that family satisfies naturality throughout the declared local morphism class.
claims.quantifiers: For every finite nonempty typed list, every marginal tuple, and every coordinatewise finite Markov kernel in the frozen local class, any natural law-valued section equals the product law; conversely the product law is a section natural under all such kernels.
claims.falsifier: Exhibit an admitted preparation kernel and marginal tuple for which naturality does not force the product, or a local kernel whose tensor pushforward does not preserve products.

claims.statement: A wide marginal-compatible category containing all frozen local kernels admits a natural section if and only if every additional morphism preserves product laws; when it exists the section is uniquely the product family, and all product-preserving morphisms form the maximal such category.
claims.quantifiers: For every wide category on the frozen finite typed objects that contains every local kernel and whose morphisms are marginal-compatible, existence of one section family natural under every category morphism is equivalent to product preservation by every morphism.
claims.falsifier: Find a marginal-compatible non-product-preserving morphism that remains natural for the product section, or a product-preserving morphism for which product naturality fails.

claims.statement: No single-valued marginal section can satisfy the section equation and be natural under both admitted correlated split refinements R_(1/3) and R_(1/2), even without assuming local-kernel naturality.
claims.quantifiers: For every single-valued law assignment satisfying the one-coordinate section equation, simultaneous naturality under the two displayed split kernels at the fair source is impossible.
claims.falsifier: Show that the two normalized split pushforwards at the fair source have different descended marginals or equal joint laws under the frozen equivalence.

claims.statement: For a smooth retained-law map and positive-semidefinite target tensor, the pullback radical is exactly the derivative preimage of the target radical; the stated transversality and locally constant-rank conditions yield a smooth positive-definite quotient bundle; a familywise Fisher-isometric commuting diagram gives the qualified pointwise quotient isometries and, on constant-rank strata, the stated bundle isomorphisms; a global quotient manifold requires the separately stated simple Hausdorff leaf-space conditions.

A diffeomorphic Fisher-isometric presentation diagram gives pointwise quotient-vector-space isometries and a surjective-submersion diagram gives the recorded pointwise fiber isometries. On strata meeting the proof's constant-rank hypotheses these assemble respectively into Q_A to Q_B over F or Q_A isomorphic to F^*Q_B.
